## Pre-Merge Quality Checklist

- [ ] **DCO Sign-off**: Every commit includes `Signed-off-by: Name <email>` (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] **Guardrails**: `pnpm guard` passes locally with 0 boundary violations.
- [ ] **Typecheck**: `pnpm typecheck` passes with no type errors.
- [ ] **Tests**: Unit/domain tests added or updated (`pnpm test`).
- [ ] **Changeset**: Added user-facing changeset if applicable (`pnpm changeset add`).
- [ ] **Documentation**: Updated meta-docs or contracts if public behavior changed.
